description: The workspace's price history: every price from a photo, link, PDF or text, newest first, whichever way it was asked (surface app for the phone app or website, api, or mcp for a chat app such as ChatGPT or Claude). Each check has its id, created_at, the item, side (selling or buying), the price with its low to high range and currency, confidence (0 to 1) and share_url. Use it to know what the person has already priced, for example to answer "what did I price last week" or before pricing the same thing again. q finds checks by words in the item's name; limit (1 to 100, default 20) sets the page size, and before takes the next_before of the last page for older checks (next_before is null on the last page). get_price_check gives one check's whole answer. Changes nothing. Until price history is switched on for your workspace it answers 404 not_released. Needs a Last Price credential with price compute scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

before.description: The next_before of the last page, for older checks.

limit.description: How many checks, 1 to 100. Defaults to 20.

q.description: Words in the item's name, for example "lamp" or "iphone".

name: list_price_checks
